title: Rating Algorithm
description: Difficulty algorithm used for the rating (reserved for future algorithm versions)

title: Sub Difficulty Scheme
description: RC/LN sub-ratings source: Direct uses the new RC/LN sub-algorithms for every chart; Legacy v0.5.1 shows LN difficulty = total

title: UI Style
description: Rating first: the star rating is the headline number. Dan first: the dan value is the headline and the star rating moves next to it. Minimal: only the dans (total, RC, LN) and the overall pattern tags

title: Panel Density
description: Standard is the full-size layout; Compact shrinks fonts, spacing and the curve to cover less of the screen

title: Color Scheme
description: Overlay palette. Aurora is the new v1.0.1 theme; High Contrast is tuned for readability over bright gameplay

title: Dan Display Style
description: Within-dan position: three segments (low/high), signs (-/+) or decimal number

title: Curve Smoothing
description: Softens the difficulty curve. Off draws the raw per-400ms values; higher settings remove more jaggedness while keeping the peaks

title: Hide While Playing
description: Hide the overlay after gameplay starts (results screen is shown again)

title: Show Map Summary
description: Display the song, difficulty name, mapper, key count, BPM, object count and length at the top of the panel

title: Show Pattern Tags
description: Display overall pattern tag chips below the rating

title: Show Current Segment
description: Display the live segment tag and equivalent bpm at the playhead

title: Show Segment Difficulty
description: Display the current segment's difficulty (star rating and dan) next to its pattern tag. 7K only; needs Show Current Segment

title: Show Segment Timeline
description: Display the full-map segment tag color band with playhead

title: Show Break Segments
description: Display 'Break' text during rest sections (timeline always shows them faded)
